# Jacques Derrida — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Jacques Derrida known for?", "Of Grammatology"),
    ("What field did Jacques Derrida work in?", "deconstruction"),

    ("What is field?", "deconstruction"),
    ("What is known for?", "Of Grammatology"),
    ("What is note?", "There is nothing outside the text"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
